traits.evidence: Dense but orderly editor chrome and aligned controls.
Nearly monochrome surfaces with black reserved for primary actions.
Large calm canvas, thin borders, soft pills, and restrained shadows.
Persistent toolbar, inspector panels, and direct manipulation workspace.

character.summary: A clean desktop creator interface with a calm light-gray canvas, white utility surfaces, precise hairline dividers, and black capsule actions.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.evidence: Main editor workspace is a very light neutral gray.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.evidence: Header and side panels are white.

tokens.name: surface_subtle
tokens.evidence: Selected rows and secondary pills use near-white gray.

tokens.name: text_primary
tokens.evidence: Primary labels and icons are near-black.

tokens.name: text_muted
tokens.evidence: Section labels and secondary values use medium gray.

tokens.name: border
tokens.evidence: Panels, pills, and rows use light one-pixel separators.

tokens.name: action_primary
tokens.evidence: Export is the dominant black capsule.

usage_notes.value: Approximately 72% white, 23% pale gray, 4% black, and 1% accent.
Use black for one primary action at a time; avoid large dark panels.
usage_notes.evidence: The reference keeps most interface chrome light.

scale.evidence: Adapted for the smaller Mockup Studio shell.
Controls rely on compact, regular-weight labels.
Secondary status text is visibly smaller and gray.

notes.value: Use restrained weights and sentence case; do not use oversized marketing headlines inside the editor.
notes.evidence: The screenshot prioritizes tools over editorial messaging.

container.evidence: Simplified from the reference to preserve the current product scope.

grid.evidence: Supports existing controls without adding mockup preset browsing or a timeline.

layout.density: compact desktop utility UI with generous canvas space

radii.evidence: Central work area uses a large soft corner.
Side panels read as edge-to-edge structural regions.
Inputs and rows use modest rounded rectangles.
Navigation and primary actions are capsules.

shadows.evidence: Used selectively on floating or selected capsule controls.

surface_notes.value: Rely on borders and surface changes before shadows.
surface_notes.evidence: Most hierarchy is structural rather than elevated.

media_types.value: large 3D product render on a neutral studio canvas
media_types.evidence: The phone render dominates the workspace.

art_direction.value: neutral background, soft controlled light, generous crop, minimal decoration
art_direction.evidence: The central scene is isolated from interface chrome.

iconography.value: simple black outline icons, approximately 18-20px, 1.5px stroke
iconography.evidence: Toolbar icons are compact and visually light.

motion.value: subtle, direct-manipulation motion with short 160-220ms UI transitions
motion.evidence: Static screenshot supplies no direct timing evidence; proposal fits the precision-led system.

do: Keep the 3D preview as the visual center of gravity.
Use white structural panels over a pale gray workspace.
Use one black capsule for the primary export action.
Keep labels short, compact, and aligned to a consistent grid.
Preserve the existing upload, view, background, motion, fit, and export functions.
do_not: Do not copy the reference logo, product thumbnails, or proprietary artwork.
Do not add preset libraries, timelines, keyframes, accounts, or pro-mode controls in this pass.
Do not use heavy shadows, saturated panels, or large editorial headings.
Do not let the inspector overpower the canvas.

decisions.value: Use the reference as a design-system source, not as a feature specification.
decisions.reason: The user requested its visual system while the project brief explicitly avoids becoming a large editor.

decisions.value: Use a strictly black, white, and gray interface with no green accent.
decisions.reason: The user explicitly declined retaining the existing green accent.
